assessments.name: Household Archaeology: A Contemporary Ethnographic Study
assessments.description: Write a contemporary archaeological investigation of a household by mapping it, tracking object use and discard, documenting daily practices over two weeks, and analyzing how these patterns reflect broader social dynamics.

assessments.name: Outline and Annotated Bibliography
assessments.description: Prepare an outline of your research essay and an annotated bibliography of at least 5 references. Together, these should clearly indicate how each source will be used to support specific claims or arguments in the essay.

assessments.name: Research Essay
assessments.description: Write a research essay on a set topic in social archaeology, using case studies of archaeological sites, material culture, or research projects to develop and support your arguments.
